entries.comment: This reduced rate applies only to computer units, accessories and special equipment for the blind and visually impaired persons: touch screen monitors; keyboards; devices contr. by hand, foot, head; switching devices; special attachments (keyboard frame); voice-contr. computer components; Braille monitor, printer; touch monitor, voice controlled systems, screen reading systems, equipment for the production of Braille and recorded material; hearing aids customised for computer.
